title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes

summary.en: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
summary.zh: 随着人工智能生成的代码不断累积，Anthropic 的新开发者工具旨在通过让代理处理日常审批来消除另一个瓶颈。

title.en: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios

summary.en: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

summary.en: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.
